method: Static source review only; no task, test, reference solution, shell snippet, or container was executed.

endless_sample.sampling_frame: 829 semantic-text candidates before literal-block and package exclusions
endless_sample.selection: First 24 SHA256(audit-semantic-v1 + task_id) values; see endless_semantic_sample_ids.json

substantive_weak_verifier_cases.issue: Requires a genuine RSA-4096 key pair and matching fingerprint; tests only key-file existence/modes, final public-key token, and fingerprint-shaped text.
Requires moving CSV source data; tests destination names and nonzero byte counts but do not verify preserved bytes.
Claims deterministic archival; final determinism test only checks a truthy MD5, and content comparison trusts mutable source files.

additional_unchecked_requirement.issue: Instruction claims final stdout COMPRESSION DONE is graded; supplied verifier checks only filesystem artifacts.

endless_sample.interpretation: These eight are a convention/observation-dependence concern, not eight secret-answer leaks. Static filters are conservative and also exclude some sound tasks. Rates are not representative of all 2492 tasks.
endless_sample.copy_flag_correction: Both COPY/ADD matches occur inside heredocs creating task Dockerfiles, not as outer image build directives. No task.json leakage was established by these flags. Neither task is in the recommended slice.

prepopulated_solution_candidate.issue: Outer Dockerfile creates the requested scaffold, exact files and a formatted setup log before the agent starts. No-op pass is plausible but UNVERIFIED without execution.

false_positive_filename_flag.issue: solution.txt is written by the broken program when it eventually succeeds, not by setup as an oracle answer.

tmax.interpretation: Six confirmed exposed answers among seven deliberately selected suspicious tasks is not a prevalence estimate. The broader 39 answer-path flags are suspects, not 39 proven leaks. No remaining task is certified safe by absence of flags.

lineage.endless: 2492 UUID task roots, no parent field. Text and normalized-verifier dedup found no merges, but failed a semantic sanity check: task_000000_0f50d50e and task_000000_52e18e5e are closely related IP/status frequency tasks with TF-IDF cosine only 0.1762. Do not call singleton components certified independent lineages.
lineage.tmax: No parent field in released parquet. Complexity/domain/skills are taxonomy labels, not independent-root identifiers.
lineage.seta: Collapse __b1/__d1 style evolution suffixes and StackOverflow/Unix question subvariants. Explicit root linkage supports 3465 source-root groups globally, and 55 in the tagged Nginx/TLS-plus-known-seed slice.
